prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-oriented 2D game UI ART ASSET SHEET, not a complete screen mockup.
Create ONE large high-resolution square PNG atlas, ideally 3072x3072, on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Exactly TWELVE separate assets in a precise THREE COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS grid. Each grid cell holds one complete isolated asset. Equal column widths and row heights. Generous transparent gutters and outer margin, at least 48 pixels at this resolution. Nothing touches another asset. All silhouettes fully visible, never cropped. Absolutely NO words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, gameplay HUD, arrows, close buttons, phone mockups, checkerboard pattern or watermark.
Art direction: premium illustrated casual puzzle game Memory Match Adventure, the moonlit botanical garden style of a commercial mobile game. Deep navy and petrol teal, aged warm gold and restrained ivory highlights. Distinct emerald, sapphire and amethyst accents for three games. Hand-painted garden architecture and tactile lightly dimensional gilded beveled rims, coherent elegant ornamentation, crisp clean UI silhouettes, no heavy bloom or glare, not generic flat-color rectangles. Practical legibility: decoration concentrated at edges/corners; broad calm dark centers for real UI content added later.
ROW ONE: THREE matching outer-size landscape game-selection background panels, rounded rectangular aspect 4:3, each completely filled by an opaque illustrated scene and a thin elegant golden botanical frame. Column 1: emerald conservatory garden with quiet stone fountain, delicate white lily-of-the-valley at the left edge, soft warm lantern at far right. Column 2: sapphire moonlit water courtyard, stone arches at the sides, subtle cyan-lit water along lower edge, blue flowers. Column 3: amethyst pavilion with violet wisteria overhead and low layered garden terraces at lower corners, warm tiny lanterns. These backgrounds represent Memory Match, Link Connect, Triple Connect, but DO NOT draw their names or any cards, game pieces or controls. Keep the central 60 percent restrained, softly shaded and open. No giant bright moon behind future text.
ROW TWO: THREE reusable POPUP BACKGROUND PANELS, matching large rounded rectangular size, aspect 4:3. These have OPAQUE dark quiet interiors, clearly designed to hold actual text and controls later. Column 1: botanical deep teal panel with refined brass rim and subtle leaf corner relief, almost plain calm center with real rich material depth. Column 2: navy-blue nighttime glass garden window panel, architectural corners only, subtly shaded smooth center, ivory/gold thin rim. Column 3: muted violet floral pavilion panel, tiny wisteria edge decoration, dark desaturated center, warm gold rim. No inset faux buttons or fake text lines. Frame thickness modest, not huge.
ROW THREE: THREE separate TITLE HEADER ORNAMENTS, all on genuine alpha around their entire outlines. Column 1: symmetrical golden leafy crest with a small central flower and gently curling branches, horizontal, no plaque or text. Column 2: elegant blank deep-teal nameplate ribbon with thin gold bevel and leaf ends, wide quiet center to place a title; shaped silhouette isolated, not a rectangle backdrop. Column 3: arched golden botanical pediment with restrained purple blossoms and a small dark-blue blank central medallion, delicate and light, no text. Keep each fully within its own cell; generous empty alpha surrounding.
ROW FOUR: THREE reusable EMPTY BORDER FRAMES, genuine alpha BOTH OUTSIDE AND THROUGH THEIR OPEN CENTERS, visibly hollow frames, no dark painted center. Column 1: landscape rounded rectangular thin gold/teal beveled frame with modest corner leaf details. Column 2: upright rounded rectangular antique-gold frame with subtle sapphire corner gems and minimal botanical detailing, suitable for a taller popup. Column 3: a low wide softly rounded gold-bordered teal outer button/nameplate rim with restrained dimensional depth, its central opening TRANSPARENT too, suitable for overlaying any background; do not draw symbols or labels. These are detached complete frame assets, not framed scenes.
Keep the full sheet visually consistent with the attractive one-large-two-small game portal menu direction. Same gold material and ornament scale throughout. The sheet is meant to be cut into individual UI assets later: clean alpha, clear separation, consistent alignment, no drop shadows extending into adjacent cells, no background canvas fill. Preserve true transparent pixels, never simulate transparency with gray checkerboards or solid black. Fine details remain readable at mobile size.
